title = "000 Sunder Kidambi"

[[Sunder Kidambi	Thu May 02 1996 - 11:53:50 PDT [Source](https://www.ramanuja.org/sri/BhaktiListArchives/Article?p=may96/0033.html)]]

Dear Bhaktas,
Greetings to you all. On this Thirunakshtram of Lord Nrusimha, I would like to
offer Swami Desikan's Kaamasikaashtakam. This file is in postscript. 

Adiyen,

Sunder Kidambi
